title: REQ · A Zustand store holds drawer, modal, sound and settings UI state
summary: Single UI store with typed actions
description: Context: drawer state is local useState in GameLayout and the contribution sheet flag is local in App. Desired behavior: one Zustand store useUiStore owns drawerOpen, modal ('contribution'|'settings'|null), soundEnabled and settingsOpen with actions. Why: Phaser and React must share UI state without duplicated ownership.
acceptance_criteria: Given the initial store, when read, then drawerOpen false, modal null, soundEnabled true, settingsOpen false
Given toggleDrawer called twice, when read, then drawerOpen is true then false
Given openModal('contribution') then closeModal, when read, then modal is 'contribution' then null
Given toggleSound called, when read, then soundEnabled is false
Given setSettingsOpen(true), when read, then settingsOpen is true
